3-1(ha): rgya gar skad du/ya ti ma hA bo d+hi tsit+Da ko Sha d+hama/mu la yA kA
3-2(ha): sha dra ta dz+nya na a kA sha nA ma/bod skad du/rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi
3-3(ha): sems mdzod kyi tshos/rtsa ba nam mkha' gnyis pa las/ye shes nam mkha'
3-4(ha): zhes bya ba/bcom ldan 'das bdud kyi stobs rab tu 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal

3-11(ha): myu gu'i tshul du 'byung ba'i dus//bskal pa tha mar rgyab gyes pa//til gyi 'bru
4-1(ha): tsam dge ba'i las//ma bsags kun bzang rang sar grol//til gyi 'bru
4-2(ha): tsam sdig pa'i las//ma byas 'gro drug khams gsum 'khor//dge sdig nang
4-3(ha): nas gang che ba//gzhi snang rtogs dang ma rtogs yin//mdzad chen gcig gi
4-4(ha): do bo bas//che ba lnga yi ka ba btsugs//thig le drug gi gdung ma bres/

4-8(ha): mon bus khyer//mdzod 'di gang gis mthong gyur pa//de tshe sangs rgyas nyag
4-9(ha): gcig rtogs//nor rdzas bzhi la longs spyad nas//dbul ba bral ba'i bdag
4-10(ha): po bzhin//yid la bsam pa yongs rdzogs nas//'dod pa thams cad rab

4-12(ha): bya//dbus na tchos 'byung chen po'i mdzod//oM gyur sngags kyi sdong po can//

4-16(ha): mkha'i sgron bu 'bar//e ma gsang ba rmad byung tshos//ye shes lhun rdzogs
4-17(ha): chen po'i skra//nu ba na ye shes khyab brdal mdzod//gsung mchog a yi rnam pa
4-18(ha): can//e ma gsang ba mad byung chos//ye shes dbyings na 'od gsal sku//
